scope.identityAssetsOwner: Parent agent; observed only in this review

method: All 521 article PNGs visually inspected in numbered contact sheets and compared against article titles/concept directions. Eleven final semantic deltas were inspected again; the final compression compact/wide label correction was inspected at full size. Unchanged images are tied to the inspected bytes by SHA256. Site PNGs and source-native NGINX diagrams were visually inspected. This is a visual subject/layout audit, not a full factual review of every article body.

cards.method: Rendered HTML markup; visible browser sizing and style need separate visual checks. Decorative SVG icons do not count.

browser.coverage: Every generated content-card route at desktop/light; eight principal page templates additionally in mobile/light, desktop/dark and mobile/dark. Each AI/training card separately captured and visually reviewed in all four variants. DOM checks measure real thumbnail dimensions/opacity/visibility and horizontal overflow.

skipLinkFinding.status: capture artifact; no product style change
skipLinkFinding.explanation: Huge section screenshots included sticky UI outside the normal viewport. Card-sized captures are clean; actual skip link is unfocused and above the visible screen.
